correctness.rationale: Exact neighborhood expressions for an omitted a_i and b_j establish a common x≤1 signature-distinctness condition; nonemptiness is completely classified when one side has zero or one sensor. The four matched-pair states count candidate profiles as (2z+z²)^n+n(2z+z²)^(n−1); precisely n²z^(n−1)+nz^n invalid profiles on each small side are subtracted, disjoint for n≥4, with six intersections restored at n=3; n=2 is directly two disjoint edges. Coefficient extraction establishes the minimum n−1 for n≥5 and its exact positive coefficient n(2^(n−1)−2n). Bernoulli weighting gives the reliability function, and binomial-to-Poisson convergence gives the limit. Exhaustive original-predicate enumeration n=2..9 and exact integer checks n=5..200 passed (VERIFY_OK); finite experiments are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Ordinary locating-dominating sets model simultaneous placement of detecting sensors whose neighborhood signatures must distinguish all unselected vertices. The exact polynomial determines every feasible deployment cardinality on the natural bipartite double covers of complete graphs, not just an extremal scalar; the minimum configurations have a sharp two-side occupancy restriction. Interpreting the polynomial as independent sensor availability yields a nontrivial n^(-1/2) critical omission scale and the exact (1+c²)e^(−c²) limiting reliability, a mathematically motivated structural and probabilistic refinement. No broad downstream theorem is needed for the natural all-set classification.
